items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingReturnsRaipur2022#16737-registrations-payments).

Please note once you register on the WCA site for this competition, 
your name will 1st be in the waiting list and only once your payment is completed will your name appear in the competitors list within 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they will have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, 
organisers will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and overall participation.
We will be dividing all the participants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration.

Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.

items.name: Get Even Mt Eden 2022

venue.name: Dominion Road School Hall
venue.address: Dominion Road School, 14 Quest Terrace, Mount Roskill, Auckland, 1041

items.information: Get Even Mt Eden 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information:
Swisscubing Cup II is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2022, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2022/ for the details of the other editions.
A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup II ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2020. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2022/.
Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.

venue.details: Cafeteria. Enter through K-5 entrance, follow signs to right.

items.information:
## **THIS IS A SERIES COMPETITION WITH PIKES PEAK GOOD AFTERNOON 2022. YOU MAY ONLY SIGN UP FOR *ONE*  OF THE COMPETITIONS.**

### Masks are recommended at this event. Competitors are only permitted to bring 1 guest, and all competitors and spectators may not attend the afternoon competition.  These policies are subject to change if the COVID "Community Level" reaches high in the county

This competition will take place in the morning from 8 AM to 12:45 PM. There is another competition occuring in the afternoon [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PikesPeakGoodAfternoon2022)

This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the *Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab*  before registering.

The competitor limit is 80 competitors. You are only permitted to bring one guest at maximum and we encourage competitors to attend alone if possible.
